statement: This review proposes an information audit retaining P/Q row labels over the subgroup field, certified consequence selection by closed degree-bounded space gain, and coordinate-defined overlapping line families with explicit cross-rank/membership/cost rejection tests. Written derivations expose formal-label tautologies, augmented-space extraction and raw-versus-closed Macaulay distinctions. They are not new checked formal theorems or measured algorithms; source-only Lean, group/rank/closure implementation and complete performance evidence remain open. The two evaluated building-block identity certificates do not close those gaps. No novelty or15x claim.
